title: One proper-support open/closed decomposition
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite intermediate field $E$ of $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$
[def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], and a scheme $T$. Use the coefficient sheaves,
internal module categories $\mathcal M_T^c(E)$ and their ordinary derived categories of
[def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. A module is locally finitely presented if it
admits a pro-etale covering on which it is a cokernel of a map between finite free modules.
A module is constructible if it has a finite locally closed stratification with constructible
underlying strata on each of which its inverse image is locally finitely presented.

Suppose the underlying topological space of $T$ is noetherian and $M\in\mathcal M_T^c(E)$
is constructible. Either $M[0]$ is a piece [def-weil-pbc-condensed-constructible-piece], or
there exist a closed immersion $i:Z\to T$ that is not surjective on points, an exact
ordinary pushforward $i_*:\mathcal M_Z^c(E)\to\mathcal M_T^c(E)$, a constructible
$M_Z\in\mathcal M_Z^c(E)$, a piece $A$, and morphisms giving a distinguished triangle
$A\to M[0]\to D(i_*)(M_Z[0])\to A[1]$ in the ordinary derived category
[def-weil-triangulated-category]. Here $D(i_*)$ is induced by the exact functor termwise.

proof.text: Apply the published coefficient-generic locally finitely presented open-piece theorem. If M is locally finitely presented everywhere (including empty T), transport it along the identity inverse-image comparison and use identity immersions to obtain a piece. Otherwise it supplies a nonempty open U on which the normalized pullback of M is locally finitely presented. Its proof uses finite-stratum interior density and immersion presentation transport, so no scheme-theoretic factorization through a stratum is assumed.

proof.text: The complement of the nonempty open $U$ gives a nonsurjective closed immersion $i:Z\to T$. The proved coefficient-compatible pullback theorem makes $M_Z=i^*M$ constructible on $Z$. No frontier condition or reduction of schemes is assumed.

proof.text: Use open/closed recollement at the complement of U. Map its bounded-below triangle to the ordinary derived category, then transport all three objects using exact-functor/single comparison isomorphisms. The first object is a piece via the identity closed immersion, using the identity direct-image comparison. In the globally locally finitely presented case, the identity inverse-image comparison and identity extension-by-zero adjunction give the first alternative.
